notes.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Making Of #02: Old vs. New
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/bffafa5fe05e8ac9e300e41d4f522722171a971f.png[/img]
[b]Barcelona, Spain / Vienna, Austria - April 15, 2025:[/b] Today, developer Alkimia Interactive has revealed new insights into the Gothic 1 Remake. The development team offered another in-depth look, as part of their making-of-series, into the creation of their ambitious project: This remake of the cult classic will not only deliver a complete visual overhaul but also introduce systemic and narrative refinements that aim to elevate the beloved original into a modern experience.

[h3]Watch the Gothic 1 Remake - Making of #2 video here: [/h3]https://youtu.be/PC-9JrKQc2I
[h3]Play the demo now:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448280

"Our job was to find out what elements should stay exactly as they are and what elements should be expanded," explains Reinhard Pollice, Alkimia Interactive's Studio Director. Throughout the production, the developers found themselves constantly navigating between honoring the original while thoughtfully enhancing it with new ideas to make the experience even more compelling. Gothic 1 Remake aims to stay true to the original’s core narrative, while addressing long-standing issues: Plot holes, contradictions, and logical inconsistencies have been carefully reviewed and rewritten.

Creating a believable, breathing open world is one of the remake’s central design goals. The team implemented a detailed living world simulation where characters follow daily routines, witness player actions, and dynamically respond to events, even when the player isn’t nearby. "We’re not just configuring NPCs’ homes or schedules.", says Javier Untoria, Lead Game Designer.

Another exciting part of the remake is how the development team expands existing areas and and found inspiration in elements that were originally cut. The development team looked at areas that were empty in the original and fleshed them out. From mysterious dungeons to hidden paths and deeper interactions with orc culture, many of the game’s lore-rich aspects are being given space to truly shine.

[h3]Gothic Sale[/h3]
For those eager to dive into the world of Gothic right away, this is the perfect opportunity! Enjoy up to [b]50%[/b] off Gothic classics and selected merch during the Spring Sale, available for a limited time over the Easter holidays: https://eu.store.thqnordic.com/Gothic-Spring-Sale/

notes.title: Step into the Colony with the Gothic Remake – Nyras Prologue at Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/5418f2592274b8d5f1ef945ebf73275b85e8c668.png[/img]
[b]Barcelona, Spain / Vienna, Austria, February 24th, 2025:[/b] Today, THQ Nordic and Alkimia Interactive are thrilled to invite players into the brutal world of Gothic 1 Remake with a standalone experience: [b]Nyras Prologue[/b]. Launching as part of [u]Steam Next Fest (February 24 – March 3)[/u], this special demo is a unique introduction to the unforgiving world of Gothic.

Watch the demo trailer here: https://youtu.be/_3VLY-B-LTg

Play the Demo now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448280/Gothic_1_Remake__Demo_Nyras_Prologue/

[b]A Different Perspective: Play as Nyras[/b]
In this self-contained prologue, players won’t step into the shoes of the Nameless Hero just yet. Instead, they will experience the Colony through the eyes of Nyras, a newly convicted prisoner struggling to survive in a ruthless environment where danger lurks around every corner.

[b]What to Expect[/b]
Nyras Prologue offers an early glimpse at the world, mechanics, and atmosphere of the full remake, built in Unreal Engine 5. However, it is important to note that this experience does not feature the intended progression, freedom, simulation, and immersion that the full game will provide. Instead, it takes place in a small section of the world with a limited set of mechanics, designed to give players a first impression of the remake’s visuals and combat.

[b]Key Details:[/b]
[list]
[*]The prologue is a standalone experience with approximately [b]one hour of gameplay[/b].
[*]Players [b]will not take on the role of the Nameless Hero but instead play as Nyras[/b], a convict trying to survive in the Colony.
[*]The prologue features challenging combat and an immersive world, but it is not representative of the full game’s depth and freedom.
[*]Built in Unreal Engine 5, it offers a first look at the rebuilt environments and updated visuals of Gothic 1 Remake.

We're rolling out the red carpet for our biggest sale of the year! To celebrate our latest announcements and all the games you love, we're slashing prices like monsters in Titan Quest II. From August 1st, 19:00 CEST / 10:00 AM PDT to August 15th, 19:00 CEST / 10:00 AM PDT, you can grab dozens of our titles at blockbuster discounts - get Darksiders III for 80% off, the Titan Quest Anniversary Edition for 80% off, or snag South Park: Snow Day at 50% off! You didn't see this one coming, even after we shared a few hints. This highly anticipated sequel takes the chaos of the racetrack to the next level with a completely overhauled physics engine that delivers unparalleled realism in every bone-crunching collision and metal-twisting crash. Get ready to dominate the track with fully customizable cars, allowing you to create your own unique wrecking machine and share your designs with fellow players around the world. notes.title: General Update - Fire Lizard Sneakpeek!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/f8c2b8749b5eddd4f2525faac7594a3b91b971c8.jpg[/img]
As you explore the sandy shores of Myrtana, watch out! Here, besides the usual lizards, you might run into fire lizards as well! Their crests glow with a red-bloody color, and their mouths spew terrible flames! These creatures are really risky! Even orcs avoid them, and not for no reason! After all, one of the ingredients for Ulu-Mulu is their tongue!

Be careful when encountering these fire beasts in the Orc lands and on the beach near the mysterious Fog Tower. For your own safety, don't forget to wear some kind of artifact that will protect you from the scorching flames! That way, dealing with them will be much easier. Otherwise, it's not just a HOT battle waiting for you, but a battle with the burning smell...

notes.title: General Update - Bloodfly Sneakpeak!
notes.content:
Hey Gothic Community! 

Gothic 1 Remake’s development is in full swing and we would like to share everything at once, but let's leave something for dessert?  

Today we decided to give you a first look at a redesigned Bloodfly! 

Do you remember how much problems do these creatures cause in the early game? You should be aware of the poisonous sting of a Bloodfly or you will get into trouble! 

To avoid them, don’t come close to the places, where the soil is damp and the air is humid! The flies gather there, attracted by the sweat of all kinds of beings. They use their stings to kill their victims and feast on their blood. 

How do you like the new design? 

Join our discord here to be part of the conversation! - [url=https://www.discord.gg/gothic]Gothic Discord[/url]

notes.title: General Update - Minecrawler Sneak Peak & Call for Community Manager Application
notes.content:
Back in March, we released a render of the actual in-game Scavenger created for the Gothic Remake to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Gothic. Since it’s been a while, we thought we would post another update. 
We really enjoyed the critical discussions and constructive feedback that came out of this post and so we will continue releasing key elements of the game that way.
Today we're bringing you a sneak peak of our interpretation of the Minecrawler.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/e77558f174ec96a90274594371446db2a75ecded.jpg[/img]
We can assure you that they’re even more terrifying moving around in-game. We also came up with a small additional twist to these creatures, but there’ll be more on that in a later update.

Generally, we are very pleased to share that the development of the Gothic Remake is progressing on all fronts. We have assembled a team of over 35 specialized developers at our Barcelona office and are working with several contractors and outsources in addition. Gothic may be more than 20 years old, but the scope of this game cannot be underestimated.

We are also still looking for additional people to join our team. If you’re interested, you can check our open positions here: www.alkimiainteractive.com

Today, we want to put a special spotlight on the open position of Community Manager at Alkimia Interactive! We are looking for a versatile person to join us at our Barcelona office and help with coordinating our communication efforts and community presence, among other things. The most important part is to be passionate about Gothic and proficient in English and German (ideally Polish or Russian as well). You can find more details here: https://alkimiainteractive.com/callforcommunitymanager.html

notes.title: APRIL, APRIL: Enhance Your Adventure – Gothic Remake to Feature In-game Store
notes.content:
[h2]Hope you have not taken that too serious ;) April, April[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/19c7fd69dc74f6820eb9355ba1773c0b06370d6c.jpg[/img]

[b]Enhance your adventure – Gothic Remake to feature in-game store[/b]
 
Barcelona, Spain / Vienna, Austria, April 1st, 2021: Gothic has just turned 20 years old, and players around the world can’t wait to put their feet back into the Colony. As THQ Nordic and developer Alkimia Interactive promised, the development process for the upcoming Gothic Remake will be as transparent as possible. And therefore, the two companies are proud to present one of the exciting new features of the Gothic Remake: The G-Store.

After analyzing all the great RPGs out there, it became quite clear that players want to have a chance to enhance and customize their adventures. With the G-Store, Alkimia Interactive and THQ Nordic will offer vast options to do so. The store will feature new equipment for the hero – you can get the legendary weapons of Diego or all-new clothes to really stand out between all the other colonists. Also, the shop will offer a large amount of quality of life items, such as healing potions, XP-boosters or creature-type focused damage-enhancers, if you are struggling to slay a troll for example. Also, if the player has spent all their learning points or attribute points in a way that doesn’t please them anymore, a full respec is also available for a small fee. 

And – for the very first time in the Gothic franchise – the G-Store will exclusively feature the most requested item-types ever: pets! If you ever felt a bit lonely while running through the wilderness, we have a solution: Get a pet! Be it a baby scavenger or a young troll, everyone will find a beloved companion.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/b1735d302085e60c409ce2487bc136cfdab4289d.jpg[/img]

Each transaction in the G-Store is done with G-Coins. These can either be purchased at a fixed rate as seen in the price list below or via viewing live streams of the game – for each hour watching the Gothic Remake in a stream, registered users will be rewarded with G-Coins. The exact offering of the in-game store depends on the community feedback and will be revealed closer to the game’s release.

G-Coins pricing overview: 
•	2.500 G-Coins for EUR/USD 12.99
•	5.000 G-Coins for EUR/USD 24.99 (+500 Bonus G-Coins)
•	10.000 G-Coins for EUR/USD 59.99 (+1000 Bonus G-Coins)
•	20.000 G-Coins for EUR/USD 99.99 (best value and +2000 Bonus G-Coins)	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085203/8286d7cdca62f23c4f2e466c64bbe0114aeb04bf.jpg[/img]
 
"[i]With the Gothic Remake, we do not simply want to make the old Gothic look shiny, we want to fully adopt the game and bring it up to 2021 standards (and probably beyond). We are all big fans of open-world RPGs in general and in almost all of them is a shop for the modern player: Hardworking in real life, earning a lot of money but having no time to spend it. For this kind of people, we offer THE perfect solution![/i]“ says Reinhard Pollice, Studio Head at Alkimia Interactive & Business and Development Director at THQ Nordic, "[i]we did a representative survey in our finance department and 100% of the people agreed, that this is a fantastic idea![/i]“ 

The Gothic Remake is currently in development for PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S. There is no official estimated release window yet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297900/

Do you want to learn more about the Gothic Remake? Check the official website:
https://www.gothic-game.com/

Stay tuned!
